words.t: n. 资格(证明)，合格证书
d: n. 资格(证明)，合格证书
n. 资格， 资格证明， 合格证书； 限制， 限定
words.x: He left school without any qualifications.
words.xm: 他离校时没有拿到任何文凭。

d: v. 胜任， 具有资格， 合格； 限定
words.x: Free school lunches are given to children who qualify.
words.xm: 符合条件的儿童可获得免费的学生午餐。

words.x: Much of the land was of poor quality.
Your work has improved in quantity and quality this term.
words.xm: 这学期你的作业在完成数量和质量上都有提高。

d: vt. 停止， 放弃； 离开， 辞
words.x: There are no failures in life, only those who quit before success.
words.xm: 生活中没有失败者，只有那些在成功前就放弃的人。

d: n. 引文， 引语， 语录； 报价， 牌价， 行情
words.x: The following quotation is taken from a nineteenth century travel diary.
words.xm: 下文引自19世纪的一篇旅行日记。

words.x: I had a terrible quarrel with my other brothers.
words.xm: 我和其他几个兄弟大吵了一架。

words.x: It’s about a page and a quarter.
words.xm: 大概是一又四分之一页。

words.x: Can I ask you a question?

words.t: n. 行列 v. 排队等候
words.x: You’ll have to join the queue.
That was quick! I thought you’d be another hour.
words.xm: 很快啊！我以为你还要一个小时呢。

words.x: We’ll have to be quiet so as not to wake the baby.
words.xm: 我们得安静点，免得吵醒宝宝。

words.x: I felt quite bitter about it at the time.
words.xm: 当时我对此感到相当痛苦。

d: n. 引文， 引语； 报价， 牌价； 引号
words.x: He quoted a short passage from the Bible.
words.xm: 他引用了《圣经》里的一小段。
